## About
Y7 Logistics (Y7 Consulting Inc., d/b/a Y7 Logistics) is a licensed FMCSA property broker specializing in auto transport across the United States. We connect shippers with vetted carriers through Central Dispatch for auction pickups, dealer trades, port deliveries, and private vehicle relocations.

## Services
- Ship My Car: /ship-my-car — Door-to-door auto transport for individuals
- For Dealers: /dealers — Volume pricing, auction pickup, weekly invoicing for auto dealers
- For Exporters: /exporters — Port delivery, gate pass coordination, warehouse management
- Car Shipping Cost: /car-shipping-cost — Pricing guide and cost calculator
- Open Car Shipping: /open-car-shipping — Standard open trailer transport
- Enclosed Car Shipping: /enclosed-car-shipping — Premium enclosed transport for luxury/classic vehicles
- Salvage Car Shipping: /salvage-car-shipping — Non-running and salvage vehicle transport
- State to State: /state-to-state-car-shipping — Interstate auto transport
- Auction Car Shipping: /auction-car-shipping — Copart, IAAI, Manheim pickup
- Copart Shipping: /copart-shipping — Direct Copart lot pickup
- IAAI Transport: /iaai-transport — IAAI auction vehicle transport
- Manheim Transport: /manheim-transport — Manheim dealer auction transport
- Dealer Auto Transport: /dealer-auto-transport — Dealer-to-dealer trade transport
- Door to Port: /door-to-port-auto-transport — Auction or residence to port delivery
- Auction to Port: /auction-to-port-transport — Auction lot to port corridor
